# marzban-vless-cluster

> Marzban panel with VLESS TCP REALITY (XTLS Vision) across several servers: one master runs the panel and Xray, each slave runs Marzban Node with its own REALITY inbound and cover site; subscriptions list all servers. Shell scripts + Docker Compose + Makefile.

Human documentation is in Russian.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, quick install
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): from a new VPS to a working subscription
- [Adding a slave node](docs/adding-a-node.md): attach a Marzban Node
- [Verification](docs/verification.md): check every layer with concrete commands
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): traffic flow, why the node inbound uses 8444
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): master/.env and slave/.env variables
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): updating, backup and restore, firewall
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms and fixes
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): common questions
- [Warnings](docs/warnings.md): DPI/IP blocking, no guarantees, server security, hosters, legal disclaimer
